action.objective: ,plete broad search over all legal White moves at depth 3-4 to identify best candidates and king-safety risks.
action.rationale: Broad search at depth 3 suggested f4d6 (score 132, exact) as the top move, but all other candidates have bound=upper and the analysis was cutoff. f4d6 captures the d6 bishop (which just moved), recapturing is not forced since f3 knight and c3 knight don't defend f4, but Bxd6 cxd6 opens lines. Actually the PV shows Bxd6 Bxf3 Bxc7 Qxc7 gxf3, winning a bishop for essentially nothing since Black's g4 bishop pin was broken. However, f4d6 result is only depth 3 and the only exact evidence. I need to verify the reserved candidate f4d6 with its 2000-node allowance.
